review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::objectives::recover_retail_objectives on zbd/c1c/m01 (directive-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: the findings document docs/findings/2026-10-12-m01-b-obj-4-mission-language-directive-keys.md records the engine-image parse sites of the five record-level keys in $CS_ENGINE_IMAGE (sha256 43540fc97347210d6f4c10b77edbd4cdab1f03d57554d638223c2430a6c37d75) and joins them with the M01-LC-DIRECTIVE findings' measured block-level directive table; the production census reports the 19 task keys as 5 record-level fields and 45 block-level directive sites in M01, each classified by its measured family rather than a generic Unmeasured, and the acceptance suite asserts the shapes, counts, values and families key for key against that census, so a drift between the document and the data fails the run. The native-side evidence is STATIC CODE EVIDENCE ONLY: parse sites, field offsets, argument arity and the transform constants were read out of the executable with r2 and no original program was run, so nothing here is verified_original runtime behaviour. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in the findings document's Unknowns section: (1) PLAYER_INIT elements 3 and 4 have no measured consumer and element 0's selection is a measured correlation, not an observed use; (2) the three animation-list stores are measured but their consumers are untraced and the lists' semantic differences are a name reading only; (3) DEDG's evaluator rewrites three member fields whose consumers are untraced world state; (4) TRAVELERS' opposite-polarity spelling, the counting mode's group id 0 and WAKE_ANIM's three trailing call arguments stay unknown; (5) a record key spelled only inside a block would be found by the engine's descending first-match lookup but not by this reader's top-level scan — no retail record spells one. `unknowns` is empty because every spelled site of the 19 keys reached a measured family. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_b_obj_4_ is unique to this task, so the 5 discovered assertions are exactly this task's tests. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
